caption: The drawing depicts a single large stoneware jug with a narrow neck, circular mouth, and a handle attached to the top. The jug is a muted beige or light gray color and has a shiny, glazed surface. There is a blue floral design painted on the front, featuring swirling stems and five-petaled flowers. Above the decorative design, the words "SEYMOUR, TROY" and the number "4" are inscribed in blue. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or elements present, keeping the focus on the jug itself.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
